# Browser dependencies

- Three.js r170: MIT, including GLTFLoader, STLLoader, ColladaLoader,
  TGALoader, BufferGeometryUtils, MeshSurfaceSampler and OrbitControls.
  [Upstream](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js); license in `three/LICENSE`.
- URDFLoader and URDFClasses: Apache-2.0.
  [Upstream](https://github.com/gkjohnson/urdf-loaders); license in `urdf/LICENSE`.

These local ES modules make the presentation self-contained under the project's
GitHub Pages subpath. No third-party CDN is needed for the robot view.
